headline: SFG @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 2.97 at MIL 4.68, with a projected total of 7.65. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: SFG moved -0.18 runs while MIL moved +0.76, changing the projected margin by -0.94 runs. The projected total climbed +0.58, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Kyle Harrison has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jung Hoo Lee, William Contreras, Andrew Vaughn, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Blake Perkins because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
